description_en: Terminates a code block in a Spark job
description_zh: 终止Spark作业中的部分代码块
name: CancelSparkReplStatement

parameters.help_en:
The application ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455888.html operation to query the Spark application ID
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。
可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455888.html接口查询Spark应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the code block in the Spark job
parameters.name: statement_id

AliyunUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account to which the cluster belongs
AliyunUid.description_zh: 集群所属的阿里云主账号

CodeState.description_en:
The execution status of the code. Valid values:
CANCELLED: The execution is canceled.
RUNNING: The execution is in progress.
SUCCEEDED: The execution is successful.
ERROR: The execution failed
CodeState.description_zh:
代码执行状态，取值如下：
CANCELLED： 执行取消
RUNNING： 执行中
SUCCEEDED： 执行成功
ERROR： 执行失败

CodeType.description_en:
The type of the code. Valid values:
SCALA
PYTHON
CodeType.description_zh:
代码的类型，取值如下：
SCALA
PYTHON

Columns.description_en: The column names of the table when the output is a table
Columns.description_zh: 当输出结果为表时，表的列名

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the execution, in milliseconds
EndTime.description_zh: 执行结束时间的毫秒级时间戳

Output.description_en: The code execution result. The value is a JSON-formatted string that complies with the Apache Livy output standard
Output.description_zh: 代码执行结果，一个JSON格式的字符串，格式上符合Apache Livy的输出标准

OutputType.description_en:
The serialization format of the execution result. The structure is a JSON object. Valid values:
TEXT: The output is text content that complies with the Apache Livy standard.
TABLE: The output is table content that complies with the Apache Livy standard
OutputType.description_zh:
执行结果的序列化格式，结构为一个JSON，取值如下：
TEXT： 输出结果为Apache Livy标准下的文本内容。
TABLE：输出结果为Apache Livy标准下的表格内容

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the execution, in milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 执行开始时间的毫秒级时间戳

StatementId.description_en: The unique ID of the code block in the Spark job
